BEAST_TYPES.//: Battle Re-work Part 11a (2026-10-16), note 06: six types from the species already in the game, each strong against two and weak to two -- kept small so it can be learned. strong: this type's moves hit those harder (11b uses BEAST_RULES.strong / weak).

beast.name: Beast
beast.about: Fur, claws and teeth: steady and strong.

bird.name: Bird
bird.about: Quick and hard to pin down.

water.name: Water
water.about: Tough hides and shells; slow to tire.

reptile.name: Reptile
reptile.about: Cold patience and a hard bite.

BEAST_TYPE_OF.//: A species' type; a few rare, magic kinds (species/colour) are Spirit whatever their species.

BEAST_RULES.//: Numbers (the Mathematician sets them against the Hunter in 11b): base: a type's health, attack, defence and speed at battle level 1; grow: what each gains a level, as a share of its base. maxLevel: battle level 1-50. strong/weak: a move's damage on a type it's strong against / one strong against it (11b). Health is on the player's scale (a level-30 pet has about 40, a level-30 player 30).

BEAST_PEN.//: The Beast Pen at the estate (note 06). stalls: battle pets it holds, by tier; up: what the next tier costs (Construction level and coins). train: battle and stat xp an hour on idle training, by tier -- about a tenth of a fight's at tier 0, a fifth, then three-tenths (note 06's 10/20/30%); idle training stops at battle level trainCap. feed: what a pet in training eats (one each feedHours, up to fullHours ahead). rest: minutes a fainted pet rests, restBase + restPerLevel a battle level, x restMult by tier; food used here cuts it by foodMinutes x its heal.

WARDEN.//: Warden Briar (Q14's name), the Beast Master's tutor -- she lives by the Pen. Narrative Designer: weathered, few words, fond of animals and not of people.
WARDEN.name: Warden Briar
WARDEN.title: Keeper of the Beast Pen
WARDEN.says: "Battle pets aren't pets. They're partners. Feed them, train them, let them rest -- and never send one out to make up for your own mistakes."
WARDEN.move: "Bring me a pet from your den and I'll take it into the Pen. Mind you: once it's run with the pack, it won't come back to a cushion by the fire."
WARDEN.fresh: "A new one? Good. The young ones settle in fastest -- no charge for those."
WARDEN.full: "The stalls are full. Build me more, or keep fewer."
